author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads dnsmasq query lines, sent over syslog to the data collector. Each query goes to DNS.
notes:
Setup:
- Run dnsmasq with --log-queries (log-queries in dnsmasq.conf) and the default log format.
- Pi-hole uses dnsmasq and logs the same query lines.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in the format log_query() writes.

Known gaps:
- log-queries=extra adds a serial number and doesn't match.
